metadata.title: Forecasting the Burden and Cost of Stroke in the United States: Projections by Sociodemographic Groups Through 2050: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
top_takeaways: U.S. stroke prevalence is projected to exceed 19.4 million adults by 2050, disproportionately affecting Black, American Indian/Alaska Native, and multiracial individuals (25%–30% in those >80 years). Inflation-adjusted annual stroke costs will quintuple to $142 billion among adults aged 45–64, necessitating urgent, equitable prevention and treatment policies.
